messages:
alex: Thinking of a short midweek picnic + potluck on Wed 6/14 at Mission Dolores Park 31st & Church — casual, bring one dish or snack to share, games welcome. Thoughts?
rachel: Love it. Can bring guacamole and chips. :avocado:
jon: Im in, though my schedule is tight  would 12:30pm be okay?
priya: 12:30 works for me. Can people bring blankets? I can pack a couple.
ale x: 12:30 great. I'll reserve a shady spot if it's sunny.
leah: I'm remote that day  can we make a quick video hangout link so remote folks can say hi?
alex: Good call. I'll create a Zoom link and post it here.
office-bot: Event draft: "Midweek Picnic & Games"  Wed Jun 14  12:30 PM  Mission Dolores Park  RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/event/xyz789
jon: Also bringing a frisbee and a travel-sized Codenames if anyone wants.
priya: I'll bring kid-safe snacks and napkins.
rachel: Anyone allergic to nuts? I have a walnut brownie option but can keep it separate.
leah: Nuts allergy here, thanks for checking!
alex: Noted  label dishes with allergens. Also, if it rains we can fallback to grabbing lunch at The Annex (indoor). React with emoji: :sunny: = picnic, :umbrella: = indoor fallback.
jon: :sunny:
priya: :sunny:
rachel: :umbrella: (call me paranoid)
leah: If weather's bad I might try to join in-person anyway.
alex: Cool  provisional plan: picnic at 12:30, Zoom link up, backup indoor spot reserved for 12:20 just in case. I'll post a final confirmation by Tues 6/13 5pm.
priya: Thanks alex  happy to help lug blankets/chairs.
jon: See you all there  or on Zoom!
office-bot: Reminder set: event confirmation message to thread on Tue Jun 13 17:00."
